title: NRG Assessment Tool — Batch Client List Schema v1.0
description: Validates Config/clients.json (the GDAP batch client list read by Invoke-NRGBatchAssessment). Enforced in CI (ci.yml, Schema Validation step). A malformed client row previously failed only at run time, mid-batch — schema validation moves that failure to the pull request. Mirrors the ScubaGear practice of machine-validating tool configuration before use.

TenantDomain.description: Primary domain used for output folder naming.

TenantId.description: Entra tenant GUID (from the OpenID configuration endpoint issuer).

DelegatedOrg.description: The .onmicrosoft.com ROUTING domain (not the primary domain) — required for GDAP delegated EXO connections.

DnsDomains.description: Domains whose SPF/DKIM/DMARC records the DNS collector resolves.

ThirdPartyEDR.description: Optional. The client's endpoint protection when it is not Microsoft Defender (e.g. "Cortex XDR"). The Defender endpoint checks are then reported as covered by it (declared, not verified) and not scored.

ClientId.description: Written by -RegisterApp: the assessment app's client ID in this tenant.

CertThumbprint.description: Written by -RegisterApp: the app-only certificate thumbprint.

OnboardedAt.description: Written by -RegisterApp: when the app was registered.

BaselineTier.description: NRG Security Baseline tier this client is held to. Optional; the assessment defaults to Standard.

Collectors.description: Opt-in collectors declared for this client (operator expectations, not proof). Keys are optional-collector catalog ids from Config/optional-collectors.json.

SharePointShell.description: Run the SharePoint Online Management Shell read (-IncludeSharePointShell) for this client.
